Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising a cooked mix of parboiled brown rice, black beans and bell peppers, topped with diced marinated chicken fillet, cheddar cheese and green onions, served with seasoned corn, bell peppers and onions and a sour cream sauce with coriander, lime juice and jalapeños. The rice blend is prepared with parboiled brown rice, black beans and diced red & green bell peppers. The chicken fillet is marinated in taco-style seasoning (with chili, onion, garlic, paprika and cumin) and diced before being added to the meal. The vegetable side consists of sweetcorn, red & green bell peppers, onions and coriander seasoned with chili powder. Accompanied by a sour cream-based sauce prepared with coriander, lime juice and jalapeños.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising seasoned cooked minced beef in a tomato-based sauce, topped with mashed potato and shredded white cheddar cheese, served with roasted green beans. The minced beef is braised in a tomato-based sauce with onion, carrot, celery, red wine and chicken stock, and seasoned with herbs (sage, fennel, thyme, rosemary, parsley) and spices (paprika, mustard, red pepper flakes). The mashed potato is prepared with sour cream, milk, butter and chives, then topped with shredded white cheddar cheese. Accompanied by roasted green beans seasoned with salt and black pepper.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising oven-baked salmon fillet served over cauliflower rice with onions, red and green bell peppers in a chili-garlic butter sauce, served with roasted broccoli and a coriander-sour cream sauce. The cauliflower rice is prepared with sautéed onions and bell peppers and seasoned with chili powder. The salmon fillet is seasoned with lime and orange juice, spiced with ancho chili powder, and oven baked before being added to the meal. Accompanied by roasted broccoli and a sour cream-based sauce prepared with coriander, jalapeño and lime.

En accompagnement, du brocoli rôti et une sauce aux notes d’orange et de citron vert apportent de la fraîcheur. Des jalapeños viennent compléter l’ensemble.

Filet de saumon cuit au four, servi sur du riz de chou-fleur aux oignons, poivrons rouges et verts dans un beurre piment-ail, avec des brocolis rôtis et une sauce coriandre à la crème.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising a creamy cauliflower rice base in a cheese and roasted garlic sauce, topped with seasoned beef meatballs, accompanied by roasted portobello mushrooms and a mushroom Stroganoff-style sauce. DKSE.Meal Story (EN): In this noodle-free twist on a comfort classic, savory beef meatballs (mixed with a blend of sautéed onions, celery, and garlic, plus porcini mushroom powder and Parmesan cheese) are plated atop a rich cauliflower "rice" gratin made with mozzarella, cream cheese, and roasted garlic. That’s paired with meaty portobellos roasted with garlic and thyme. On the side, a Dijon-spiked mushroom cream sauce is perfect for spooning over the meatballs.
DKSE.Meal Story (DK): Klassisk comfort – i en nyfortolkning uden nudler. Saftige oksekødboller røres med sauterede løg, selleri og hvidløg samt porcini-svampepulver og parmesan for ekstra dybde. De serveres på en cremet blomkåls-“ris” gratin med mozzarella, flødeost og ristet hvidløg. Ved siden af får du kødfulde portobellosvampe, ovnristet med hvidløg, timian og rosmarin. Retten rundes af med en cremet svampesauce med dijon – perfekt over kødbollerne.
DKSE.Meal Story SE: Här bjuds på en twist av en riktig klassiker. Smakrika köttbullar på nötfärs (blandade med fräst lök, selleri, vitlök, porcinipulver och parmesan) serveras med en fyllig blomkålsgratäng gjord på mozzarella, färskost och vitlök. Som tillbehör serveras ugnsrostad portobellosvamp och en krämig svampsås med dijonsenap som är perfekt att ringla över köttbullarna.

DKSE.Meal Story (EN): Every element of this dish is infused with classic and comforting American flavors. Tender pulled chicken thigh is topped with cheddar cheese, crispy bacon, and green onions, then served over a luscious cream cheese sauce infused with ranch seasoning, a garlic and herb blend that packs a savory punch. Two satisfying sides round out the meal: portobello mushrooms roasted with olive oil, garlic, and thyme, and garlic broccoli.
DKSE.Meal Story (DK): Klassiske, amerikanske comfort-smage i hver bid. Mør pulled chicken toppes med cheddar, sprød bacon og forårsløg og serveres på en cremet flødeostsauce med ranch-krydderi – en smagfuld blanding af hvidløg og urter. Ved siden af får du portobellosvampe ovnristet med olivenolie, hvidløg og timian samt broccoli med hvidløg.
DKSE.Meal Story SE: Varje del av denna måltid är fylld med klassiska smaker inspirerade av det amerikanska köket. Mör pulled chicken toppas med cheddarost, knaperstekt bacon och salladslök. Kycklingen serveras på en bädd av krämig färskostsås med ranchkrydda (en blandning av vitlök och örter). Måltiden kompletteras med två smakrika tillbehör: ugnsrostad portobellosvamp med olivolja, vitlök och timjan, samt vitlöksdoftande broccoli.

DKSE.Meal Story (EN): Enjoy a delicious chef-made meal without the preparation and cleanup. Here, beef is braised until fall-apart tender, then cloaked in a toasted garlic and Parmesan cream sauce. It’s served with potatoes roasted with rosemary and thyme, tender bell peppers, and roasted broccoli with a dollop of savory Parmesan-chive butter to melt over the top.
DKSE.Meal Story (DK): En klassiker med et twist: saftigt oksekød, sprøde grøntsager og masser af smag på tallerkenen. Her braiseres kødet mørt, til det falder fra hinanden, og vendes i en cremet sauce med ristet hvidløg og parmesan. Det serveres med ovnbagte kartofler med rosmarin og timian, saftige peberfrugter og ovnristet broccoli toppet med parmesan-purløgssmør, der smelter over retten.
DKSE.Meal Story SE: Njut av långkokt högrev, så mört att det faller isär, i en krämig sås på rostad vitlök och parmesan. Måltiden serveras med ugnsrostad potatis med rosmarin och timjan, paprika och broccoli. Som pricken över i:et toppas allt med ett smakrikt parmesan- och gräslökssmör som får smälta över den varma maten.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked marinated shrimp with spinach and brown basmati rice topped with lemon-garlic sauce, served with zucchini, cauliflower and balsamic glazed tomatoes. The rice blend is prepared with brown basmati rice, spinach, onion and feta cheese, and seasoned with dill, oregano and garlic. The shrimp is marinated with cayenne pepper, fennel, garlic, basil, oregano and rosemary before cooking. The lemon-garlic sauce is prepared with milk, lemon juice, parmesan cheese, parsley and seasonings. Accompanied by oven-roasted zucchini with garlic, roasted cauliflower florets with garlic and chives, and cherry tomatoes glazed with balsamic vinegar, basil and onion.

DE.PC Product Description - DE:
Kräftige mediterrane Aromen stehen bei diesem griechisch inspirierten Gericht im Mittelpunkt. DKSE.Meal Story (EN): Vibrant Mediterranean flavours shine in this Greek-inspired dish. Juicy shrimp are roasted and topped with a rich roasted tomato and feta sauce that brings depth and a gentle tang. They’re served over fluffy brown Jasmine rice with lemon and dill for a fresh, aromatic kick. On the side, roasted courgette and burst cherry tomatoes add sweetness and colour.
DKSE.Meal Story (DK): Friske middelhavssmage kendetegner denne græsk-inspirerede ret. Saftige rejer ovnbages og toppes med en fyldig tomat-fetasauce med både dybde og let syre. Serveret på brune jasminris med citron og dild, der giver et friskt, aromatisk løft. Ved siden af får du ovnbagt zucchini og søde, bagte cherrytomater, som afrunder retten.
DKSE.Meal Story SE: En grekiskinspirerad rätt med smaker från Medelhavet. Saftiga räkor toppas med en smakrik tomat- och fetasås med mild syrlighet. Räkorna serveras med luftigt fullkornsris smaksatt med citron och dill. Vid sidan om finns rostad zucchini och körsbärstomater som balanserar rätten med sin naturliga sötma.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked diced marinated chicken fillet in a chili–tomato cream sauce, topped with roasted green onions, served with cauliflower topped with mozzarella cheese. The chicken is marinated with red wine vinegar, garlic and parsley before cooking and combined with a creamy sauce prepared with cream, cream cheese, parmesan cheese, tomato purée, spinach and gochugaru chili. The cauliflower florets are roasted with garlic and gochugaru chili before being topped with mozzarella cheese.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Cooked ground beef seasoned with Dijon mustard, served with roasted thick-sliced chestnut mushrooms, potatoes, and red onions. The dish is finished with a creamy sauce made from Emmentaler cheese, spreadable dairy product, whole milk, and roasted red bell pepper. Topped with green onions, olive oil, and seasonings including garlic, onion, tomato, porcini mushroom, parsley, black and white pepper. The sauce is thickened with xanthan gum (E415).

A side of roasted salt & pepper green beans completes the meal.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked marinated pork tenderloin over lemon brown basmati rice with almonds and apricots, topped with roasted cherry tomatoes and oregano-tomato butter, served with roasted zucchini and bell peppers and a lemon-dill yogurt sauce. The brown basmati rice is prepared with lemon and combined with almonds and apricots. The pork tenderloin is marinated with garlic, oregano and paprika before cooking. The cherry tomatoes are roasted. The meal is topped with a compound butter prepared with oregano and tomato. Verden Meal Database.Meal Name: Pulled Pork in Spicy Citrus Marinade
Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked pulled pork in a citrus-garlic sauce served over a wild rice blend with black beans and peppers, topped with roasted green onions and accompanied by smoky cauliflower florets. The wild rice blend is prepared with long grain rice, garlic and chopped coriander (cilantro). The black bean component consists of stewed black beans with bell peppers, onion and garlic. The pulled pork is sous vide cooked and combined with a mojo-style sauce prepared from orange juice, lime juice and garlic. Finished with roasted green onions. Accompanied by roasted cauliflower florets seasoned with garlic and chili powder.
Verden Meal Database.Dutch Descriptor: Gegaarde pulled pork in een citrus-knoflooksaus op rijst, zwarte bonen en paprika, afgewerkt met lente-ui, geserveerd met bloemkool.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked marinated chicken fillet served with creamy polenta, spinach in a white wine and cheese sauce topped with mozzarella, and spiced cauliflower florets. The creamy polenta is prepared with grits, milk, Parmesan cheese, mascarpone and butter. The chicken breast is marinated with garlic and Italian seasoning before grilling. The spinach is sautéed with garlic and combined with a creamy sauce prepared with white wine, milk, heavy cream, onion, cream cheese and Parmesan cheese. Finished with mozzarella. Accompanied by cauliflower florets roasted and seasoned with garlic and gochugaru chili pepper flakes.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked whole wheat penne pasta with steamed spinach in a creamy sun-dried tomato sauce, topped with Parmesan cheese and served with herb roasted zucchini. The whole wheat penne pasta is cooked before assembly. The spinach is steamed. The sun-dried tomato sauce is prepared with heavy cream, milk, Parmesan cheese, onion, hydrated sun-dried tomatoes and garlic. The meal is finished with grated Parmesan cheese and accompanied by zucchini roasted with herbs and seasonings.

DE.Meal Story DE: Dieses warme, herzhafte Gericht sorgt für echten Wohlfühlgenuss. Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked lemon pepper marinated chicken breast served with carrot and pea brown rice pilaf, Parmesan broccoli and rosemary carrots in a lemon herb cream cheese sauce. The brown basmati rice pilaf is prepared with carrots, onion, garlic and steamed peas. The chicken breast is marinated with vinegar, garlic and parsley before cooking. The lemon herb cream cheese sauce is prepared with cream cheese, heavy cream, semi-skimmed milk, garlic and chives. The broccoli is cooked and finished with grated Parmesan cheese. Accompanied by carrots seasoned with rosemary and coated with the cream cheese sauce.

It’s draped in a creamy lemon sauce and served atop brown rice pilaf studded with peas and carrots, perfect for soaking up the rich sauce. Meal DB_Product.[NO LONGER IN USE] \nMeal description (F: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked lemon pepper marinated chicken breast served with carrot and pea brown rice pilaf, Parmesan broccoli and rosemary carrots in a lemon herb cream cheese sauce. The brown basmati rice pilaf is prepared with carrots, onion, garlic and steamed peas. The chicken breast is marinated with vinegar, garlic and parsley before cooking. The lemon herb cream cheese sauce is prepared with cream cheese, heavy cream, semi-skimmed milk, garlic and chives. The broccoli is cooked and finished with grated Parmesan cheese. Accompanied by carrots seasoned with rosemary and coated with the cream cheese sauce.

Meal DB_Product.Sub Name: with Basmati Rice & Coriander-Cumin Cream
Meal DB_Product.Meal story (customer-facing): This comforting dish is filled with fragrant spices and bold flavors. Ground beef is simmered in rich coconut milk spiced with curry powder and garam masala and then finished with tomatoes, green peas, and coriander. It’s spooned over brown and white basmati rice tossed in a tangy coriander sauce, then topped with garlicky roasted potatoes. A side of cauliflower florets seasoned with cumin, coriander ad garlic completes the meal.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising oven-baked salmon fillet served with seasoned potatoes topped with roasted onions and red bell peppers, accompanied by green beans and creamy lemon and dill sauce. The salmon fillet is prepared with Greek yogurt, smoked paprika and cumin before baking. The seasoned potatoes are roasted and prepared with garlic, parsley and oregano. The topping consists of roasted red bell peppers prepared with garlic and cooked diced Spanish onions. The green beans are seasoned with garlic. Accompanied by a creamy lemon and dill sauce prepared with yogurt, sour cream, milk, garlic lemon and dill .

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Oven-baked salmon fillet, placed on top of quinoa cooked with concentrated tomato and water, and mixed with a cumin-spiced mix of roasted bell peppers and onions (green and red peppers, cumin, paprika, chili powder, coriander). The salmon is topped with additional pepper mix. Served with zucchini and corn seasoned with onion, garlic, coriander, and chili, and accompanied by a sour cream-based ají verde sauce made with coriander, lime, garlic, and jalapeño.

DKSE.Meal Story (EN): Our creamy, spicy ají verde sauce elevates every dish it touches with its punchy, herbaceous flavor. Here you’ll drizzle it over succulent roasted salmon that’s been marinated with Peruvian-style spices. The salmon is nestled on a bed of cumin-spiced quinoa dotted with tomatoes and bell peppers and served with a medley of roasted zucchini and corn.
DKSE.Meal Story (DK): Ovnbagt laks marineret med peruvianske krydderier, toppet med en cremet og let spicy ají verde-sauce med friske urter. Serveret på en bund af quinoa smagt til med spidskommen, med tomat og peberfrugt. Dertil en blanding af ovnristet zucchini og majs.
DKSE.Meal Story SE: Vår krämiga, kryddiga aji verde-sås förgyller denna måltid med sin distinkta och friska smak. Ringla den över saftig, ugnsrostad lax som har marinerats i kryddor inspirerade av det peruanska köket. Laxen serveras på en bädd av quinoa smaksatt med spiskummin. Som tillbehör får du tomater samt en blandning av rostad zucchini, majs och röd paprika.

DKSE.Meal Story (EN): Savor the flavors of a home-cooked meal in this rich and comforting plate. Beef is braised until fall-apart tender and topped with creamy jus and thyme-roasted pearl onions. It’s served over a luxurious base of sour cream and onion-mashed potatoes flecked with minced chives. For the vegetable side, broccoli and carrot coins are roasted with rosemary and dolloped with Parmesan-herb butter.
DKSE.Meal Story (DK): Braiseret oksekød tilberedt, til det er mørt og falder fra hinanden, toppet med en cremet sky og perleløg ristet med timian. Serveret på en fyldig kartoffelmos med syrnet fløde og løg, vendt med finthakket purløg. Dertil ovnristet broccoli og gulerødder med rosmarin, afsluttet med parmesan- og urtesmør.
DKSE.Meal Story SE: Njut av smaken av hemlagat i denna fylliga och värmande rätt. Oxköttet bräseras tills det är så mört att det faller isär och toppas sedan med en krämig skysås och timjanrostad silverlök. Till detta serveras en bädd av potatismos smaksatt med gräddfil, lök och finhackad gräslök. Som tillbehör serveras ugnsrostad broccoli och morot med rosmarin. Grönsakerna toppas med ett smakrikt smör på parmesan och örter.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked garlic and herb marinated diced chicken fillet over roasted cauliflower and zucchini, topped with tomato-yogurt sauce and green peas, served with a basmati rice and cauliflower blend. The zucchini is roasted with garlic. The cauliflower florets are seasoned with cumin, chives and garlic before roasting. The diced chicken fillet is marinated with garlic, herbs and seasonings before cooking. The tomato-yogurt sauce is prepared with Greek yogurt, tomatoes, green peas, ginger, garlic, curry and coriander. The meal is topped with steamed green peas. The rice and cauliflower blend is prepared with white and brown basmati rice, cauliflower, ginger, garlic, sliced onion, coriander and sesame oil.

Köttet serveras på en bädd av råris och blomkålsris som toppats med rostad kål, morötter och rikligt med vitlök. Målltiden fulländas med ingefärsrostad paprika och serveras med chili- och vitlöksstekt zucchini.

DKSE.Meal Story (DK): Sydøstasiens aromatiske smage er i fokus i denne ret. Mør barramundi marineret med ingefær og hvidløg serveres med brune jasminris og en cremet gul thaikarrysauce. DKSE.Meal Story SE: Havsabborre med ingefära och vitlök serveras i en len thailändsk gul currysås tillsammans med fullkornsris. Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked diced marinated chicken fillet over brown rice with tomatoes and roasted bell peppers, topped with tomato sauce and toasted sliced almonds, served with a roasted carrot, zucchini and bell pepper blend. The brown jasmine rice is prepared with tomatoes, red onion and cumin-roasted red and green bell peppers. The diced chicken fillet is marinated with lemon juice, garlic and paprika before cooking. The tomato sauce is prepared with tomatoes, bell peppers, onion, garlic, cumin and smoked paprika. The meal is topped with a chunky tomato salsa prepared with tomatoes, onion, garlic, coriander and lime juice, and finished with toasted sliced almonds. Accompanied by carrots roasted with coriander and garlic, together with roasted zucchini and bell peppers.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked marinated barramundi fillet served over a ginger and garlic brown jasmine rice blend, topped with seasoned spinach and black sesame seeds, accompanied by green beans and a honey-miso sauce. The brown jasmine rice blend is prepared with ginger and garlic. The barramundi fillet is marinated with onion, garlic, ginger, tamari and sesame seeds before cooking. Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked marinated salmon fillet over tomato-turmeric rice with cauliflower, topped with pistachios and served with garlic-honey carrots and a cumin-coriander yogurt sauce. The rice and cauliflower blend is prepared with brown jasmine rice, cauliflower, turmeric, red and green onion, ginger, garlic and a tandoori spice blend containing cumin, paprika and garlic. The rice is further flavored with tomatoes, lemon juice and vinegar. The salmon fillet is marinated with a tandoori spice blend prepared with cumin, paprika, ginger and garlic before cooking. The meal is topped with pistachios. The carrots are cooked with honey, garlic and coriander. Accompanied by a yogurt sauce prepared with Greek yogurt, lime juice and cumin.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked herb-marinated chicken fillet over a creamy potato and leek purée, topped with a basil, spinach and almond sauce, served with roasted green beans and roasted cherry tomatoes. The potato and leek purée is prepared with steamed potatoes, roasted leeks with garlic, cream cheese, milk, heavy cream and sour cream. The chicken fillet is marinated with herbs and seasonings before cooking. The sauce is prepared with spinach , sliced almonds, Parmesan cheese and basil. The green beans are roasted with sliced onion and seasoning. Accompanied by roasted cherry tomatoes prepared with balsamic vinegar.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked marinated pork tenderloin over lemon brown basmati rice with almonds and apricots, topped with roasted cherry tomatoes and oregano-tomato butter, served with roasted zucchini and bell peppers and a lemon-dill yogurt sauce. The brown basmati rice is prepared with lemon and combined with almonds and apricots. The pork tenderloin is marinated with garlic, oregano and paprika before cooking. The cherry tomatoes are roasted. The meal is topped with a compound butter prepared with oregano and tomato. The zucchini is roasted with garlic, and the red and green bell peppers are roasted with garlic. Accompanied by a yogurt sauce prepared with Greek yogurt, lemon juice and fresh dill.

DKSE.Meal Story (DK): Inspireret af den klassiske Philly cheese steak er dette keto-måltid fyldigt og smagfuldt. Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked zaatar-marinated salmon fillet coated with black and white sesame seeds over a turmeric wild rice blend with cranberries, dates and cashews, mixed with roasted bell peppers, served with honey-glazed carrots and a whipped feta yogurt sauce. The wild rice blend is prepared with turmeric and combined with carrots, cranberries, dates, cashews and parsley. The bell peppers are fire-roasted and seasoned with cumin and cilantro. The salmon fillet is seasoned with oregano, thyme, and black and white sesame seeds before cooking. The carrots are glazed with honey and prepared with gochugaru chili pepper flakes, lemon juice and fresh mint. Accompanied by a whipped sauce prepared with feta cheese, Greek yogurt and lemon juice.

Meal DB_Product.[NO LONGER IN USE] \nMeal description (F: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked zaatar-marinated salmon fillet coated with black and white sesame seeds over a turmeric wild rice blend with cranberries, dates and cashews, mixed with roasted bell peppers, served with honey-glazed carrots and a whipped feta yogurt sauce. DE.PC Product Description - DE:
Inspiriert von der levantinischen Küche wird das mit Zaatar gewürzte Lachsfilet auf feuergerösteter Paprika mit Kreuzkümmel und Koriander sowie aromatischem Kurkuma-Reis serviert. Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising oven-baked salmon fillet served over cauliflower rice with onions, red and green bell peppers in a chili-garlic butter sauce, served with roasted broccoli and a coriander-sour cream sauce. The cauliflower rice is prepared with sautéed onions and bell peppers and seasoned with chili powder. The salmon fillet is seasoned with lime and orange juice, spiced with ancho chili powder, and oven baked before being added to the meal. Accompanied by roasted broccoli and a sour cream-based sauce prepared with coriander, jalapeño and lime.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising oven-baked salmon fillet with creamy Gochugaru-tomato sauce and spinach, garnished with roasted green onions, served with zucchini topped with sesame seeds. The salmon fillet is seasoned with garlic and salt before oven baking. The sauce is prepared with cream, cream cheese, parmesan cheese, tomato purée, spinach and Gochugaru chili. The meal is topped with roasted cherry tomatoes and roasted green onions. Accompanied by julienne-style zucchini seasoned with oil and salt and finished with roasted sesame seeds.

Den vitlöksdoftande laxen serveras i såsen och toppas med salladslök. För extra grönsaker har vi gömt lite spenat i såsen. Som tillbehör serveras zucchinispaghetti med sesamfrön.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked marinated pork tenderloin over lemon brown basmati rice with almonds and apricots, topped with roasted cherry tomatoes and oregano-tomato butter, served with roasted zucchini and bell peppers and a lemon-dill yogurt sauce. The brown basmati rice is prepared with lemon and combined with almonds and apricots. The pork tenderloin is marinated with garlic, oregano and paprika before cooking. The cherry tomatoes are roasted. The meal is topped with a compound butter prepared with oregano and tomato. The zucchini is roasted with garlic, and the red and green bell peppers are roasted with garlic. Accompanied by a yogurt sauce prepared with Greek yogurt, lemon juice and fresh dill.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising oven-baked salmon fillet served over cauliflower rice with onions, red and green bell peppers in a chili-garlic butter sauce, served with roasted broccoli and a coriander-sour cream sauce. The cauliflower rice is prepared with sautéed onions and bell peppers and seasoned with chili powder. The salmon fillet is seasoned with lime and orange juice, spiced with ancho chili powder, and oven baked before being added to the meal. Accompanied by roasted broccoli and a sour cream-based sauce prepared with coriander, jalapeño and lime.

FR.Meal Story (EN): Every element of this dish is infused with classic and comforting American flavors. Tender pulled chicken thigh is topped with cheddar cheese, crispy bacon, and green onions, then served over a luscious cream cheese sauce infused with ranch seasoning, a garlic and herb blend that packs a savory punch. Two satisfying sides round out the meal: portobello mushrooms roasted with olive oil, garlic, and thyme, and garlic broccoli.
FR.Meal Story (FE): Un plat généreux, pensé pour les grandes faims. Le poulet effiloché est garni de cheddar, de bacon croustillant et d’oignons nouveaux, puis servi avec une sauce au fromage frais relevée d’un mélange d’ail et d’herbes façon ranch. En accompagnement, des champignons portobello rôtis à l’huile d’olive, à l’ail et au thym, ainsi que du brocoli à l’ail pour ajouter une touche de légumes à l’ensemble.

Dazu kommen ingwergeröstete Paprika und eine Beilage aus Chili-Knoblauch-Zucchini.
DE.PC Product Description - DE:
Zartes, gezupftes Rindfleisch erhält durch unsere koreanisch inspirierte Bulgogi-Sauce aus Knoblauch, Ingwer, Chili, geröstetem Sesamöl, Tamari und Reisessig eine süß-herzhafte und angenehm würzige Note. Dazu kommen ingwergeröstete Paprika und eine Beilage aus Chili-Knoblauch-Zucchini.

DKSE.Meal Story (EN): Tender shredded beef gets a punch of sweet, savory, tangy flavor thanks to our Korean-style bulgogi sauce made with garlic, ginger, chili pepper, toasted sesame oil, tamari, and rice vinegar. It’s set over a brown rice and cauliflower “rice” blend topped with roasted cabbage, carrots, and plenty of garlic. The main course is finished with ginger-roasted bell peppers and served with a side of chile-garlic zucchini.
DKSE.Meal Story (DK): Mørt pulled beef vendt i en koreansk-inspireret bulgogi-sauce med hvidløg, ingefær, chili, ristet sesamolie, tamari og riseddike. Serveret på en blanding af brune basmatiris og blomkålsris, toppet med ristet kål, gulerødder og ekstra hvidløg. Retten afrundes med ingefær-ristede peberfrugter og serveres med zucchini med chili og hvidløg ved siden af.
DKSE.Meal Story SE: Mör pulled beef får en kraftfull balans av sött, salt och syrligt tack vare vår koreansk-inspirerade bulgogi-sås gjord på vitlök, ingefära, chilipeppar, rostad sesamolja, tamari och risvinäger. Köttet serveras på en bädd av råris och blomkålsris som toppats med rostad kål, morötter och rikligt med vitlök. Målltiden fulländas med ingefärsrostad paprika och serveras med chili- och vitlöksstekt zucchini.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked marinated shrimp with spinach and brown basmati rice topped with lemon-garlic sauce, served with zucchini, cauliflower and balsamic glazed tomatoes. The rice blend is prepared with brown basmati rice, spinach, onion and feta cheese, and seasoned with dill, oregano and garlic. The shrimp is marinated with cayenne pepper, fennel, garlic, basil, oregano and rosemary before cooking. The lemon-garlic sauce is prepared with milk, lemon juice, parmesan cheese, parsley and seasonings. Accompanied by oven-roasted zucchini with garlic, roasted cauliflower florets with garlic and chives, and cherry tomatoes glazed with balsamic vinegar, basil and onion.

DKSE.Meal Story (EN): This spin on classic French ratatouille is comfort food at its finest. We cooked zucchini, tomatoes, bell pepper, and onion in deeply fragrant roasted garlic oil, then mixed in rosemary, parsley, and basil for even more flavor. A topping of peppery toasted hemp and sunflower seeds adds crunch to every spoonful. To complement the rustic stew, we paired it with white corn polenta, made creamy and rich with mascarpone cheese.
DKSE.Meal Story (DK): En fortolkning af klassisk fransk ratatouille. Zucchini, tomater, rød peberfrugt og løg tilberedes i ristet hvidløgsolie og vendes med rosmarin, persille og basilikum. Toppet med ristede hampfrø og solsikkekerner for tekstur. Serveret med cremet polenta lavet på majsgryn og afrundet med mascarpone, Parmigiano Reggiano, smør og mælk. Smagen rundes af med fennikel, honning, olivenolie, sort peber og et strejf af purløg.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked marinated chicken fillet served with creamy polenta, spinach in a white wine and cheese sauce topped with mozzarella, and spiced cauliflower florets. The creamy polenta is prepared with grits, milk, Parmesan cheese, mascarpone and butter. The chicken breast is marinated with garlic and Italian seasoning before grilling. The spinach is sautéed with garlic and combined with a creamy sauce prepared with white wine, milk, heavy cream, onion, cream cheese and Parmesan cheese. Finished with mozzarella. Accompanied by cauliflower florets roasted and seasoned with garlic and gochugaru chili pepper flakes.

DKSE.Meal Story (DK): Klassisk comfort – i en nyfortolkning uden nudler. Saftige oksekødboller røres med sauterede løg, selleri og hvidløg samt porcini-svampepulver og parmesan for ekstra dybde. De serveres på en cremet blomkåls-“ris” gratin med mozzarella, flødeost og ristet hvidløg. Ved siden af får du kødfulde portobellosvampe, ovnristet med hvidløg, timian og rosmarin. Retten rundes af med en cremet svampesauce med dijon – perfekt over kødbollerne.
DKSE.Meal Story SE: Här bjuds på en twist av en riktig klassiker. Smakrika köttbullar på nötfärs (blandade med fräst lök, selleri, vitlök, porcinipulver och parmesan) serveras med en fyllig blomkålsgratäng gjord på mozzarella, färskost och vitlök. Som tillbehör serveras ugnsrostad portobellosvamp och en krämig svampsås med dijonsenap som är perfekt att ringla över köttbullarna.

Finished with feta cheese topping.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked zaatar-marinated salmon fillet coated with black and white sesame seeds over a turmeric wild rice blend with cranberries, dates and cashews, mixed with roasted bell peppers, served with honey-glazed carrots and a whipped feta yogurt sauce. The wild rice blend is prepared with turmeric and combined with carrots, cranberries, dates, cashews and parsley. The bell peppers are fire-roasted and seasoned with cumin and cilantro. The salmon fillet is seasoned with oregano, thyme, and black and white sesame seeds before cooking. The carrots are glazed with honey and prepared with gochugaru chili pepper flakes, lemon juice and fresh mint. Accompanied by a whipped sauce prepared with feta cheese, Greek yogurt and lemon juice.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising a cooked mix of parboiled brown rice, black beans and bell peppers, topped with diced marinated chicken fillet, cheddar cheese and green onions, served with seasoned corn, bell peppers and onions and a sour cream sauce with coriander, lime juice and jalapeños. The rice blend is prepared with parboiled brown rice, black beans and diced red & green bell peppers. The chicken fillet is marinated in taco-style seasoning (with chili, onion, garlic, paprika and cumin) and diced before being added to the meal. DKSE.Meal Story (EN): Packed with savory Mexican-style flavors, each element of this dish comes together to form one exciting bowl. Juicy pulled chicken, seasoned with our house-made taco seasoning, is served over black beans and brown rice. It’s all accented with a roasted corn salsa made with spicy jalapeño peppers, red bell peppers, cilantro, paprika, cumin, and chili powder. The meal is finished with a creamy cilantro sour cream, perfect for drizzling over the top.
DKSE.Meal Story (DK): En bowl med fyldige, mexicansk-inspirerede smage. Saftig pulled kylling krydret med taco-krydderi serveres på en base af brune basmatiris og sorte bønner. Toppet med en varm majssalsa med jalapeño, rød og grøn peberfrugt, rødløg og koriander, afrundet med paprika, spidskommen og chili. En cremet creme fraiche med koriander og et strejf af lime samler retten.
DKSE.Meal Story SE: Saftig, pulled chicken – smaksatt med vår egen tacokrydda – serveras på en bädd av svarta bönor och basmati-råris. Måltiden får sin karaktär av en salsa på rostad majs, jalapeño, röd paprika, koriander, spiskummin och chilipulver. Allt toppas med en krämig koriander-gräddfil som är perfekt att ringla över vid servering.

Chicken breast is marinated in olive oil, red wine vinegar and Italian seasoning, grilled to juicy perfection, then placed atop roasted sliced mushrooms and creamy mashed potatoes that are dressed up with sour cream, shredded cheddar, and chives. Gestoomde aardappelen worden gepureerd met geroosterde prei, roomkaas en zure room, en vervolgens geserveerd onder een hele kipfilet die is gekruid met Italiaanse kruiden en gegrild. Gekookte gemarineerde kipfilet geserveerd met een aardappel-preipuree, maïs, courgette en kruiden-Parmezaanse boter.

We start with a pile of mashed cauliflower infused with cheese, and top it with tender, oven-roasted slices of pork tenderloin, which have been marinated in rosemary, sage, and thyme. Ved siden af serveres grønne bønner i en flødesovs med svampe, der tilføjer endnu mere fylde til retten.
DKSE.Meal Story SE: En värmande måltid med fylliga smaker. Saftig fläskfilé marinerad med rosmarin, salvia och timjan ugnsrostas och serveras med ett krämigt blomkålsmos med ost. DKSE.Meal Story (EN): This satisfying meal starts with a bed of sautéed green cabbage tossed in a luscious cheese sauce. Tender ground beef, simmered in a tomato sauce with onions, garlic, and Parmesan, is spooned over top and then garnished with gooey cheddar cheese. On the side are green beans and red bell peppers roasted with garlic and gochugaru (Korean chili flakes) for a touch of heat.

Ovenpå lægges mørt hakket oksekød i en tomatbaseret sauce med løg, hvidløg og parmesan, toppet med smeltet cheddar. Ved siden af får du grønne bønner og rød peberfrugt, ovnristet med hvidløg og gochugaru (koreanske chiliflager) for et let spicy twist.

Vi adderar även lite gochugaru (koreanska chiliflakes) för en kryddig twist.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked herb-marinated chicken fillet over a creamy potato and leek purée, topped with a basil, spinach and almond sauce, served with roasted green beans and roasted cherry tomatoes. The potato and leek purée is prepared with steamed potatoes, roasted leeks with garlic, cream cheese, milk, heavy cream and sour cream. The chicken fillet is marinated with herbs and seasonings before cooking. The sauce is prepared with spinach , sliced almonds, Parmesan cheese and basil. The green beans are roasted with sliced onion and seasoning. Accompanied by roasted cherry tomatoes prepared with balsamic vinegar.

En enkel klassiker, der lader råvarerne tale for sig selv. Grillet kyllingefilet marineret med krydderurter serveres på en cremet kartoffel-porremos med grønne bønner og cherrytomater. En pesto af spinat, basilikum, parmesan og mandler tilfører masser af frisk smag.

Tilberedt marineret kyllingefilet på en cremet kartoffel-porremos toppet med en basilikum-spinat-mandelsauce, serveret med ovnbagte grønne bønner og cherrytomater.
DKSE.PC Product Description - SE:

DKSE.Meal Story (EN): This succulent pulled chicken is inspired by Morocco’s famed tagines, and flavored with cumin, ginger, chilies, and coriander. It’s served over spiced potatoes along with a vibrant chili-infused tomato sauce that’s packed with jalapeños. Tender green beans stewed with spices and tomatoes, plus a creamy yogurt sauce on the side provide the perfect balance for this flavor-packed meal.
DKSE.Meal Story (DK): Marokkansk-inspirerede smage i en fyldig og aromatisk ret. Saftig pulled chicken krydres med spidskommen, ingefær, chili og koriander og serveres med krydrede kartofler. Dertil får du en intens tomatsauce med jalapeños, der giver varme og dybde. Møre grønne bønner med krydderier og tomat afrunder retten, mens en cremet yoghurtsauce skaber balance.
DKSE.Meal Story SE: Denna saftiga pulled chicken är smaksatt med spiskummin, ingefära, chili och koriander. Den serveras på en bädd av örtpotatis tillsammans med en färgstark chili- och tomatsås fylld med jalapeños. Till detta serveras haricots verts med kryddor och tomat, samt en krämig yoghurt som ger den perfekta balansen till denna smakrika måltid.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising seasoned cooked minced pork in a tomato-based sauce, topped with mashed potato and shredded white cheddar cheese, served with roasted green beans. The minced pork is braised in a tomato-based sauce with onion, carrot, celery, red wine and chicken stock, and seasoned with herbs (sage, fennel, thyme, rosemary, parsley) and spices (paprika, mustard, red pepper flakes). FR.Meal Story (EN): Vibrant Mediterranean flavours shine in this Greek-inspired dish. Juicy shrimp are roasted and topped with a rich roasted tomato and feta sauce that brings depth and a gentle tang. They’re served over fluffy brown Jasmine rice with lemon and dill for a fresh, aromatic kick. On the side, roasted courgette and burst cherry tomatoes add sweetness and colour.
FR.Meal Story (FE): Un plat inspiré de la cuisine grecque, aux saveurs méditerranéennes bien équilibrées. Les crevettes sont rôties puis nappées d’une sauce aux tomates rôties et à la feta, légèrement acidulée. Elles sont servies sur du riz jasmin complet parfumé au citron et à l’aneth. En accompagnement, des courgettes rôties et des tomates cerises confites apportent une touche plus douce et ensoleillée.

DKSE.Meal Story (EN): Few things can transform a dish like the one-two, savory-sweet combo of miso and honey. Here, garlic and some crunchy sesame seeds join that dynamic duo to elevate tender brined chicken, with ginger-scallion rice making each bite that much better. Steamed edamame brings little pops of extra flavor, as do garlic-roasted carrots.
DKSE.Meal Story (DK): Sød honning og fyldig miso er en kombination, der løfter enhver ret. Her får du mør kylling med en sauce af honning, miso og hvidløg, toppet med ristede sesamfrø. Hertil serveres ris med forårsløg og ingefær samt edamamebønner og ovnbagte gulerødder med hvidløg. En velafbalanceret kombination af søde, salte og umamirige smage.
DKSE.Meal Story SE: Få smakkombinationer lyfter en rätt som balansen mellan sött och salt från honung och miso. Här får den duon sällskap av vitlök och krispiga sesamfrön som kompletterar den saftiga kycklingen. Ris med ingefära och salladslök sätter extra smak på varje tugga, medan edamamebönor och vitlöksrostade morötter bidrar med både smak och textur.

DKSE.Meal Story (EN): Travel to North Africa with this bold, Tunisian-inspired bowl. Tender chicken is marinated in red wine vinegar, garlic, parsley, and aromatic spices, then simmered in a rich tomato-based sauce. It’s served over a bed of fluffy brown basmati rice alongside a colorful roasted medley of bell peppers, courgette, and carrots. To finish, a sprinkle of toasted almond shavings adds the perfect crunch to this deeply comforting meal.
DKSE.Meal Story (DK): Inspireret af de varme og aromatiske smage fra det tunesiske køkken. Marineret kylling med rødvinseddike, hvidløg, persille og krydderier serveres i en fyldig tomatbaseret sauce. Hertil får du brune basmatiris samt en farverig blanding af ovnbagt peberfrugt, zucchini og gulerødder. Sprøde mandelflager tilfører et lækkert crunch og fuldender de varme og fyldige smage.
DKSE.Meal Story SE: Tunisiskt kryddad kyckling tillagad i en fyllig tomatsås och serverad med fullkornsris. Tillsammans med rostad zucchini, morötter och paprika blir det en smakrik måltid med inspiration från Nordafrika. Rostade mandelspån på toppen ger rätten ett härligt krisp.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked marinated pork tenderloin over lemon brown basmati rice with almonds and apricots, topped with roasted cherry tomatoes and oregano-tomato butter, served with roasted zucchini and bell peppers and a lemon-dill yogurt sauce. The brown basmati rice is prepared with lemon and combined with almonds and apricots. The pork tenderloin is marinated with garlic, oregano and paprika before cooking. The cherry tomatoes are roasted. The meal is topped with a compound butter prepared with oregano and tomato. The zucchini is roasted with garlic, and the red and green bell peppers are roasted with garlic. Accompanied by a yogurt sauce prepared with Greek yogurt, lemon juice and fresh dill.

Lean ground beef is simmered in a tomato sauce loaded with roasted garlic, onion and warm baking spices, then tossed with roasted eggplant before being smothered in bechamel sauce. Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked marinated barramundi fillet served over a ginger and garlic brown jasmine rice blend, topped with seasoned spinach and black sesame seeds, accompanied by green beans and a honey-miso sauce. The brown jasmine rice blend is prepared with ginger and garlic. The barramundi fillet is marinated with onion, garlic, ginger, tamari and sesame seeds before cooking. The spinach is seasoned with a vegetable marinade containing ginger, garlic, green onion, rice vinegar, honey, sesame oil and miso paste, and is finished with black sesame seeds. The green beans are prepared with sesame oil and granulated green onion. Accompanied by a honey-miso sauce prepared with sesame oil, ginger, garlic, miso paste, honey, rice vinegar and lime juice.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked marinated salmon fillet over tomato-turmeric rice with cauliflower, topped with pistachios and served with garlic-honey carrots and a cumin-coriander yogurt sauce. The rice and cauliflower blend is prepared with brown jasmine rice, cauliflower, turmeric, red and green onion, ginger, garlic and a tandoori spice blend containing cumin, paprika and garlic. The rice is further flavored with tomatoes, lemon juice and vinegar. The salmon fillet is marinated with a tandoori spice blend prepared with cumin, paprika, ginger and garlic before cooking. The meal is topped with pistachios. The carrots are cooked with honey, garlic and coriander. Accompanied by a yogurt sauce prepared with Greek yogurt, lime juice and cumin.

Meal DB_Product.Meal story (customer-facing): Bring the vibrant flavors of India right to your table. A salmon fillet is coated in a bold Tandoori dry rub and seared to perfection, then set atop a bed of fragrant Tandoori-spiced rice. DKSE.Meal Story (EN): Bring the vibrant flavors of India right to your table. A salmon fillet is coated in a bold Tandoori dry rub and seared to perfection, then set atop a bed of fragrant Tandoori-spiced rice. It’s paired with a colorful side of honey-glazed carrots, for a touch of natural sweetness, and roasted cauliflower florets tossed with cilantro and cumin. To tie it all together, a creamy cumin-coriander yogurt adds a fresh, tangy finish.
DKSE.Meal Story (DK): Inspireret af klassiske indiske smage. En laksefilet vendes i en aromatisk tandoori-krydderiblanding og steges til perfektion, før den serveres på en bund af duftende tomat- og gurkemejeris. Ved siden af får du glaserede gulerødder, som tilfører en naturlig sødme, samt ovnbagt blomkål vendt med koriander og spidskommen. Det hele afrundes med en cremet yoghurt med spidskommen og koriander, som tilfører friskhed og balance til hver eneste bid.

Rätten rundas av med en krämig yoghurt med spiskummin och koriander som tillför fräschör och balans i varje tugga.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked garlic and herb marinated diced chicken fillet over roasted cauliflower and zucchini, topped with tomato-yogurt sauce and green peas, served with a basmati rice and cauliflower blend. The zucchini is roasted with garlic. The cauliflower florets are seasoned with cumin, chives and garlic before roasting. The diced chicken fillet is marinated with garlic, herbs and seasonings before cooking. The tomato-yogurt sauce is prepared with Greek yogurt, tomatoes, green peas, ginger, garlic, curry and coriander. The meal is topped with steamed green peas. The rice and cauliflower blend is prepared with white and brown basmati rice, cauliflower, ginger, garlic, sliced onion, coriander and sesame oil.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Name: Pulled Pork in Spicy Citrus Marinade
Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked pulled pork in a citrus-garlic sauce served over a wild rice blend with black beans and peppers, topped with roasted green onions and accompanied by smoky cauliflower florets. The wild rice blend is prepared with long grain rice, garlic and chopped coriander (cilantro). The black bean component consists of stewed black beans with bell peppers, onion and garlic. The pulled pork is sous vide cooked and combined with a mojo-style sauce prepared from orange juice, lime juice and garlic. Finished with roasted green onions. Accompanied by roasted cauliflower florets seasoned with garlic and chili powder.

Meal DB_Product.Sub Name: with Vegetarian Chili, Sweet Potato & Jalapeño Cream
Meal DB_Product.Meal story (customer-facing): This meal features our Mexican-inspired spin on the classic tamale, here in spicy vegetarian bowl form. We start with a masa corn cake, and top it with a hearty three-bean medley, which gets simmered with red bell peppers and jalapeños, plus ancho and chipotle powder for an extra kick. It’s sprinkled with cheese for salty, tangy notes, and served with a cilantro-jalapeño crema, perfect for drizzling over top. Mexican-spiced sweet potatoes, roasted with red bell peppers and onions, make for a satisfying side.
